questions.stem: Two resistors of 6 Ω and 3 Ω are connected in parallel. What is the total resistance?
questions.explanation: Using 1/R_total = 1/R1 + 1/R2 = 1/6 + 1/3 = 1/6 + 2/6 = 3/6 = 1/2. Therefore R_total = 2 Ω. The total resistance in parallel is always less than the smallest individual resistance.
